description: A format specification for describing a visual identity to coding agents. DESIGN.md gives agents a persistent, structured understanding of a design system.
readme: A format specification for describing a visual identity to coding agents. DESIGN.md gives agents a persistent, structured understanding of a design system. A DESIGN.md file combines machine-readable design tokens (YAML front matter or interleaved YAML code blocks) with human-readable design rationale (markdown prose). Tokens give agents exact values. Prose tells them why those values exist and how to apply them.
